segments.snp4.16:4.3: Rukkhamūlaṃ susānaṃ vā, pabbatānaṃ guhāsu vā.
segments.snp4.16:5.3: Yehi bhikkhu na vedheyya, nigghose sayanāsane.
segments.snp4.16:8.1: “Kaṃ so sikkhaṃ samādāya, ekodi nipako sato;
segments.snp4.16:10.1: “Pañcannaṃ dhīro bhayānaṃ na bhāye, bhikkhu sato sapariyantacārī;
segments.snp4.16:12.1: “Ātaṅkaphassena khudāya phuṭṭho, sītaṃ atuṇhaṃ [accuṇhaṃ (sī. syā.)] adhivāsayeyya;
segments.snp4.16:12.3: So tehi phuṭṭho bahudhā anoko, vīriyaṃ parakkammadaḷhaṃ kareyya.
segments.snp4.16:13.1: “Theyyaṃ na kāre [na kareyya (sī. syā. ka.)] na musā bhaṇeyya, mettāya phasse tasathāvarāni;
segments.snp4.16:13.3: Yadāvilattaṃ manaso vijaññā, kaṇhassa pakkhoti vinodayeyya.
segments.snp4.16:14.1: “Kodhātimānassa vasaṃ na gacche, mūlampi tesaṃ palikhañña tiṭṭhe;
segments.snp4.16:14.3: Athappiyaṃ vā pana appiyaṃ vā, addhā bhavanto abhisambhaveyya.
segments.snp4.16:15.3: Aratiṃ sahetha sayanamhi pante, caturo sahetha paridevadhamme.
segments.snp4.16:16.1: “Kiṃsū asissāmi kuvaṃ vā [kudha vā (ka.), kutha vā (niddesa)] asissaṃ, dukkhaṃ vata settha kvajja sessaṃ;
segments.snp4.16:16.3: Ete vitakke paridevaneyye, vinayetha sekho aniketacārī.
segments.snp4.16:17.1: “Annañca laddhā vasanañca kāle, mattaṃ so jaññā idha tosanatthaṃ;
segments.snp4.16:17.3: So tesu gutto yatacāri gāme, rusitopi vācaṃ pharusaṃ na vajjā.
segments.snp4.16:19.3: Vācaṃ pamuñce kusalaṃ nātivelaṃ, janavādadhammāya na cetayeyya.
segments.snp4.16:20.1: “Athāparaṃ pañca rajāni loke, yesaṃ satīmā vinayāya sikkhe;
segments.snp4.16:20.3: Rūpesu saddesu atho rasesu, gandhesu phassesu sahetha rāgaṃ.
segments.snp4.16:21.1: “Etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, bhikkhu satimā suvimuttacitto;
segments.snp4.16:22.1: Kāmaṃ guhañca duṭṭhā ca, suddhañca paramā jarā;
segments.snp4.16:22.3: Metteyyo ca pasūro ca, māgaṇḍi purābhedanaṃ.
segments.snp4.16:23.1: Kalahaṃ dve ca byūhāni [byūhāni (sī.)], punadeva tuvaṭṭakaṃ;

lines: 968-9. Sattamagāthāya kyāssa byappathayo assūti kīdisāni tassa vacanāni assu.
